gene.aggregation: maximum successor novelty within one branch, bounded0..1, never cumulative
gene.boundary: visible pixels and executed-action-derived history only; no position, geometry, labels, route or native fact inputs
gene.distance: minimum reference mean absolute difference after discarding largest floor(10percent) coordinate differences
gene.limitations: Four sampled references forget older views; rotation/occlusion/texture noise can earn bonus. Measure these effects; no anti-spin guarantee.
gene.reference_source: exact actor visual_history four lagged samples with valid flags
gene.representation: frozen bundle conditioned 10x16 coarse grayscale; same conditioning as actor history

native.full_game_caveat: Unmodified IWAD native rewards can all be zero; event evidence is not silently converted into utility
native.target_boundary: Native action values have different units from bootstrap expert action codes; do not silently mix them as replay labels
native.value_source: sum of native game rewards only

contract.native_success_dominates: navigation native goal+1 and at most560tics cost.056; bonus<=.05 cannot outweigh a goal
contract.success: native navigation exit remains the only competence/gate success
contract.target: compare same native branches with beta0 control and beta.05 candidate; bounded preference conversion is separate
